description: This file contains automated test cases for the functions analyzeAllowlistByToolType and buildPluginToolGroups, which are related to plugin tool permissions and grouping in a plugin policy context. It uses the vitest testing framework to validate behavior of these functions with various allowlist configurations.

methods.name: analyzeAllowlistByToolType
methods.description: Analyzes the provided allowlist to determine if it is plugin-only, known, or includes unknown entries, based on plugin groups and core tools.

methods.name: buildPluginToolGroups
methods.description: Constructs groups of tools based on plugin metadata, filtering out tools without plugin IDs.

ctags.name: emptyPlugins
ctags.pattern: /^    const emptyPlugins: PluginToolGroups = { all: [], byPlugin: new Map() };$/

ctags.name: policy
ctags.pattern: /^    const policy = analyzeAllowlistByToolType({ allow: ["*"] }, pluginGroups, coreTools);$/

ctags.name: policy
ctags.pattern: /^    const policy = analyzeAllowlistByToolType({ allow: ["apply_patch"] }, pluginGroups, coreTool/

ctags.name: policy
ctags.pattern: /^    const policy = analyzeAllowlistByToolType({ allow: ["lobster"] }, emptyPlugins, coreTools);$/

ctags.name: policy
ctags.pattern: /^    const policy = analyzeAllowlistByToolType({ allow: ["lobster"] }, pluginGroups, coreTools);$/
